notes.title: v1.08 hotfix
notes.content: Should have fixed an issue where you could buy infinite upgrades immediately after prestiging

notes.title: v1.07 updates
notes.content:
[list]
[*] There's a little star on those panels that show a critters stats when hovered and in battle if they're shiny
[*] All areas before a club that you've completed will now be the same level as that club. Previously areas only levelled up to the Champion's level when you defeated the Champion
[/list]

notes.title: v1.06 patch fixes
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where running into a Vineberus would appear as a blank sprite and crash the game
Fixed the number of club trainers required for the club leader to appear not resetting when changing areas
